summary: XWELL, Inc. disclosed on Form 8-K that its subsidiary XpresTest, Inc. repurchased 279.5 restricted stock award shares for roughly $2.7 million, or $9,634.09 per share, on October 8, 2026, with Chairman Bruce T. Bernstein, CEO Ezra T. Ernst and CFO Ian Brown participating. The move front-runs the July 6, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement to sell XpresTest and XpresSpa Holdings to Express Wellness Group, LLC. Post-repurchase XWELL owns all XpresTest stock, eliminating minority overhang. Watch closing conditions, buyer consent and Nasdaq-effect risk.
